query:
SELECT 
  b.id,
  b.name,
  b.organizationId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(s.createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06' THEN s.id END) as june_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(i.createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06' THEN i.id END) as june_inventory
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN sales_transactions s ON b.id = s.branchId
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON b.id = i.branchId
GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.organizationId
HAVING june_sales > 0 OR june_inventory > 0
ORDER BY b.organizationId, b.id;
